RegistrationInfo.Description: 132d factor IC refresh (candidate mode): scripts/Zhuanqian_FactorIC132d.bat runs scripts/factor_ic_132d_refresh.py --max-stocks 1000 --quiet --staleness-days 14. It emits a timestamped CANDIDATE plus a per-factor diff against data/factor_ic/factor_ic_latest.json and prints [STALE] when that authority is 14+ days old. It does NOT use --apply on purpose: the v10_exact_132d engine that produced the authority was never committed, so auto-overwriting would silently corrupt the gate evidence. Switch to --apply only after the engine is blessed. Ledger: cron_config.json events.factor_ic_132d_refresh.
